audience: service businesses that take online bookings with Buk.ng

useCases.title: Check what customers can book
useCases.text: List the services with their duration, price and whether each one is bookable now.

useCases.title: Review bookings for a period
useCases.text: List bookings by date range or status, with the service, customer, staff and payment. Pass the cursor to read more pages.

useCases.title: Find a customer and their visits
useCases.text: Find one customer by email or phone, then list the bookings in a date range to see their visits.

useCases.title: Measure booking page and website traffic
useCases.text: Read visits to the booking page, the visitor sources and the live website figures for the business.

useCases.title: Confirm the key and the business
useCases.text: Read the key's scopes and mode, and the business name and timezone.
